_doc.answers: Copier answers used to render this series: OCA's defaults, with the organisation-specific questions replaced by the placeholder tokens in 'placeholders'.
_doc.ci: What OCA's rendered CI workflows use: test images (runtime Python), the PostgreSQL image, the pre-commit job's Python and the hooks it SKIPs.
_doc.deviations: Always empty in this data. The data records OCA's values verbatim; the standards engine applies (and documents) every deviation.
_doc.eslint_esm_globs: Globs eslint.config.cjs parses as ES modules (sourceType module).
_doc.exclude: OCA's top-level pre-commit exclude: a verbose regex split into its top-level alternatives, each with the comment above it. 'moved_to_per_hook' marks the alternative the standards engine moves into per-hook excludes. 'excluded_addons_markers' delimits the region oca-update-pre-commit-excluded-addons rewrites.
_doc.files: Fully rendered bodies of the files the engine manages, by file name.
_doc.hooks: OCA's hooks in config order. Each merges the hook repository's manifest with the config entry (config wins), so 'entry' plus 'args' is the command a 'language: system' hook runs. 'tool' names the 'tools' entry that provides the executable (null for 'language: fail' hooks); 'upstream_language' is the language OCA runs it with; 'key' is unique when an id repeats.
_doc.placeholders: Placeholder tokens standing for organisation-specific answers, with the copier question, OCA's default and every data path that contains the token.
_doc.pylint: Parsed .pylintrc and .pylintrc-mandatory: message lists per file, the [ODOOLINT] options (with placeholders), the optional-only messages.
_doc.python: default_language_version.python, ruff's target-version, the Python of OCA's test image and of its pre-commit job.
_doc.reference_files: Other rendered files, for reference and tests; not managed whole.
_doc.template: The OCA template and tag the data was generated from.
_doc.template_revs: The template's raw repo_rev pins for this series, including tools the rendered config does not use.
_doc.tools: Exact pins for every tool, keyed by tool name. 'requirement' is what a uv or npm lock should resolve; 'used' is false for pins the rendered config does not use; a null version means OCA does not pin the tool.

# NOT INSTALLABLE ADDONS
# END NOT INSTALLABLE ADDONS
# Files and folders generated by bots, to avoid loops
^setup/|/static/description/index\.html$|
# We don't want to mess with tool-generated files
.svg$|/tests/([^/]+/)?cassettes/|^.copier-answers.yml$|^.github/|^eslint.config.cjs|^prettier.config.cjs|
# Maybe reactivate this when all README files include prettier ignore tags?

/static/(src/)?lib/|
# Repos using Sphinx to generate docs don't need prettying
^docs/_templates/.*\.html$|

readme/.*\.(rst|md)$|
# Ignore build and dist directories in addons
/build/|/dist/|
# Ignore test files in addons
/tests/samples/.*|

(LICENSE.*|COPYING.*)

# OCA rules
!static/lib/
reference_files..pre-commit-config.yaml:
exclude: |
  (?x)
  # NOT INSTALLABLE ADDONS
  # END NOT INSTALLABLE ADDONS
  # Files and folders generated by bots, to avoid loops
  ^setup/|/static/description/index\.html$|
  # We don't want to mess with tool-generated files
  .svg$|/tests/([^/]+/)?cassettes/|^.copier-answers.yml$|^.github/|^eslint.config.cjs|^prettier.config.cjs|
  # Maybe reactivate this when all README files include prettier ignore tags?
  ^README\.md$|
  # Library files can have extraneous formatting (even minimized)
  /static/(src/)?lib/|
  # Repos using Sphinx to generate docs don't need prettying
  ^docs/_templates/.*\.html$|
  # Don't bother non-technical authors with formatting issues in docs
  readme/.*\.(rst|md)$|
  # Ignore build and dist directories in addons
  /build/|/dist/|
  # Ignore test files in addons
  /tests/samples/.*|
  # You don't usually want a bot to modify your legal texts
  (LICENSE.*|COPYING.*)
default_language_version:
  python: python3.12
  node: "22.9.0"
repos:
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      # These files are most likely copier diff rejection junks; if found,
      # review them manually, fix the problem (if needed) and remove them
      - id: forbidden-files
        name: forbidden files
        entry: found forbidden files; remove them
        language: fail
        files: "\\.rej$"
      - id: en-po-files
        name: en.po files cannot exist
        entry: found a en.po file
        language: fail
        files: '[a-zA-Z0-9_]*/i18n/en\.po$'
      - id: obsolete dotfiles
        name: obsolete dotfiles
        entry: found obsolete files; remove them
        files: '^(\.travis\.yml|\.t2d\.yml|CONTRIBUTING\.md|\.prettierrc\.yml|\.eslintrc\.yml)$'
        language: fail
  - repo: https://github.com/sbidoul/whool
    rev: v1.3
    hooks:
      - id: whool-init
  - repo: https://github.com/oca/maintainer-tools
    rev: 31bdbd8e4cb94be6534f0e82b1cafb84a455f671
    hooks:
      # update the NOT INSTALLABLE ADDONS section above
      - id: oca-update-pre-commit-excluded-addons
      - id: oca-fix-manifest-website
        args: ["@@repo_website@@"]
      - id: oca-gen-addon-readme
        args:
          - --addons-dir=.
          - --branch=18.0
          - --org-name=@@org_slug@@
          - --repo-name=@@repo_slug@@
          - --if-source-changed
          - --keep-source-digest
          - --convert-fragments-to-markdown
      - id: oca-gen-external-dependencies
  - repo: https://github.com/OCA/odoo-pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v0.0.33
    hooks:
      - id: oca-checks-odoo-module
      - id: oca-checks-po
        args:
          - --disable=po-pretty-format
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: prettier
        name: prettier (with plugin-xml)
        entry: prettier
        args:
          - --write
          - --list-different
          - --ignore-unknown
        types: [text]
        files: \.(css|htm|html|js|json|jsx|less|md|scss|toml|ts|xml|yaml|yml)$
        language: node
        additional_dependencies:
          - "prettier@3.3.3"
          - "@prettier/plugin-xml@3.4.1"
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: eslint
        name: eslint
        entry: eslint
        args:
          - --color
          - --fix
        verbose: true
        types: [javascript]
        language: node
        additional_dependencies:
          - "eslint@9.12.0"
          - "eslint-plugin-jsdoc@50.3.1"
          - "globals@16.0.0"
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.6.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
        # exclude autogenerated files
        exclude: /README\.rst$|\.pot?$
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
        # exclude autogenerated files
        exclude: /README\.rst$|\.pot?$
      - id: debug-statements
      - id: fix-encoding-pragma
        args: ["--remove"]
      - id: check-case-conflict
      - id: check-docstring-first
      - id: check-executables-have-shebangs
      - id: check-merge-conflict
        # exclude files where underlines are not distinguishable from merge conflicts
        exclude: /README\.rst$|^docs/.*\.rst$
      - id: check-symlinks
      - id: check-xml
      - id: mixed-line-ending
        args: ["--fix=lf"]
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.6.8
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        args: [--fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix]
      - id: ruff-format
  - repo: https://github.com/OCA/pylint-odoo
    rev: v9.1.3
    hooks:
      - id: pylint_odoo
        name: pylint with optional checks
        args:
          - --rcfile=.pylintrc
          - --exit-zero
        verbose: true
      - id: pylint_odoo
        args:
          - --rcfile=.pylintrc-mandatory
reference_files.checklog-odoo.cfg:
[checklog-odoo]
ignore=
    WARNING.* 0 failed, 0 error\(s\).*
    WARNING .* Killing chrome descendants-or-self .*
    WARNING.* Missing widget: res_partner_many2one for field of type many2one.*
    (?ms)WARNING.* odoo.addons.base.models.assetsbundle: Error: argument `[$]color` of `rgba[(][$]color, [$]alpha[)]` must be a color.*odoo/addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/scss/mixins/_buttons.scss, in mixin `button-outline-variant`.*
